senses.gloss: f. (צפח; v. צִיפּוּחָא) a tenacious batter dripped on a hot griddle, a sort of waffle.
units: Makhsh. V, 9 חוץ מן דבש הזיפין והצ׳ except the connected flow (נִצּוֹק) of thick honey or of a batter; [Maim., taking זיפין a. צ׳ as pr. n. pl., except the flow of honey from Zifin or Tsappaḥath, v. זִיף II, III]; Naz. 50ᵃ והצַפִּיחִית (= b. h. צַפִּיחִת); Sot. 48ᵇ והצַפִּיחִים.—[For b. h. צַפּחַת pitcher, cmp. טְפִיחַ.].
